description: Pin the no-change-means-no-tick ruling (2026-07-17, roadmap.rst) for index_of reached through a repeated HIT: the list re-sends the value the item already matched, released hgraph re-emits the same index, hgraph elides it. The sibling repeated-MISS recipe was pinned by fingerprint on issue #810 item 6.2, which this recipe showed does not generalise; both are now covered by the tsl-index-of-no-retick family. Accepted on issue #917.
